name: Architecture docs sync
description: After a Flyway migration, the build file, the Compose file or the architecture tests are saved, bring the architecture documentation up to date.

action.prompt:
A file that defines the system's structure was saved (a Flyway migration, pom.xml, docker-compose.yml, or an ArchUnit test). Check whether documentation now disagrees with the code and fix only what is actually out of date.

- Migration: compare the tables, columns, constraints and indexes it creates or alters with the 'Data model' section of docs/architecture.md and with the data model in the owning spec's design.md under .kiro/specs/. Update both to match the migration if the change was intended; if the migration contradicts the spec without an obvious reason, report it instead. Confirm the file is a new V<n>__<snake_case>.sql and that no previously applied migration was edited (check git status / git diff for modified migration files); an edited applied migration is an error to report, not to document.
- pom.xml: if a dependency was added, check it against 'Deliberately not used' in .kiro/steering/tech.md and confirm there is a one-line justification ready for the commit message. Do not copy version numbers into the docs.
- docker-compose.yml: keep the Deployment section of docs/architecture.md, docs/setup.md and .env.example consistent with service names, ports and environment variables.
- ArchUnit test: keep the 'Rules enforced by ArchUnit' list and the module dependency table in docs/architecture.md consistent with the rules in code.

The steering files in .kiro/steering/ are the agreed contract. If one of them is now wrong, do not edit it on your own: state the exact sentence that needs to change and why, and ask for confirmation.

Reply with the list of documentation edits made, or one line saying the docs already match.
